description: Reset Your Brain Naturally | Sitar Instrumental | 1.5 Hours — steady, bright sitar to clear a cluttered mind.
Ninety minutes of sitar in Raga Yaman with soft tabla: unhurried, steady, and clear — music to let the mental noise settle and think straight again.
🎧 HOW TO USE — low volume, let it run. Good for a reset break, study, or slow work.
⏱ BEST FOR — mental clutter · overthinking · a brain that needs a reset · focus without strain
🎵 ABOUT — Raga Yaman is the evening-bright raga of clarity; on sitar, its long steady phrases give a restless mind something clean to follow.
